wow-frostmourne-base-description.Text: A runeblade of impossible cold. It has begun to listen for the souls of those struck by its edge.

wow-frostmourne-taker-description.Text: Awakened by thirty stolen souls, Frostmourne answers its wielder with the power to tear at a victim's spirit from afar.

wow-frostmourne-hungering-description.Text: Sixty souls writhe within the blade. Its hunger sharpens both edge and will.

wow-frostmourne-bane-description.Text: With ninety souls imprisoned, Frostmourne can bind the living in merciless supernatural ice.

wow-frostmourne-herald-description.Text: One hundred and twenty souls herald an endless winter. The runeblade's cold reaches far beyond its edge.

wow-frostmourne-end-description.Text: At one hundred and fifty souls Frostmourne stands fully awakened, able to reap a spirit with a single final judgement.

wow-frostmourne-flavor.Text: Whomsoever takes up this blade shall wield power eternal. Just as the blade rends flesh, so must power scar the spirit.

wow-frostmourne-strike-description.Text: Strike one target with Frostmourne. Costs 1 AP and may be selected outside combat for testing.

wow-frostmourne-cleave-description.Text: Sweep Frostmourne through an arc, striking all targets in the affected area. Costs 2 AP and may be selected outside combat for testing.

wow-frostmourne-soulrend-description.Text: Unleash a dark spectral ray that tears at one victim's soul. Costs 1 AP, adds no veil degradation, and is available from V2. It may be used outside combat for testing.

wow-frostmourne-chains-description.Text: Encase one target in supernatural ice and bind it in place. Costs 2 AP, adds no veil degradation, and is available from V4. It may be used outside combat for testing.

wow-frostmourne-harvest-description.Text: Deliver Frostmourne's final judgement, dealing 200% weapon damage with 100% armour penetration. Costs 2 AP and is available from V6. It may be used outside combat for testing.

wow-frostmourne-souls-description.Text: Each stack is one soul claimed from an enemy previously damaged by Frostmourne. The blade awakens at 30, 60, 90, 120, and 150 souls.
